title: Luciferase Reporter Assay for NF-kB Activation - Protocol 3: Treatment
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare and load test articles
steps.instruction: Dilute each test article in DMEM to the desired concentrations, then dispense 150 µL of each dilution into the corresponding wells of a Corning 96‑Well Plate (360 µL flat format) that will serve as the source plate.

steps.title: Process Slot 2
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from the reporter‑cell plate located in Slot 2, then add 100 µL of the test article from Slot 1 to each well, and finally replenish the 300 µL pipette tips on Slot 3 manually.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from reporter cells in Slot 2.
Transfer 100 µL of test article from Slot 1 to each well in Slot 2.

steps.title: Process Slot 5
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from the reporter‑cell plate in Slot 5, add 100 µL of the test article from Slot 4 to each well, and replenish the 300 µL tips on Slot 3 manually.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from reporter cells in Slot 5.
Transfer 100 µL of test article from Slot 4 to each well in Slot 5.

steps.title: Process Slot 8
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from the reporter‑cell plate in Slot 8, add 100 µL of the test article from Slot 7 to each well, and replenish the 300 µL tips on Slot 3 manually.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from reporter cells in Slot 8.
Transfer 100 µL of test article from Slot 7 to each well in Slot 8.

steps.title: Process Slot 11
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from the reporter‑cell plate in Slot 11, then add 100 µL of the test article from Slot 10 to each well.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from reporter cells in Slot 11.
Transfer 100 µL of test article from Slot 10 to each well in Slot 11.

steps.title: Incubate cells off‑deck
steps.instruction: Place the reporter‑cell plates back into the incubator (off‑deck) and continue the cell culture incubation as required for the assay.
